messages:
alex_dev: Quick q — console UX for per-tier routing + fallback + quota. Current editor feels ambiguous about precedence when a tenant has an explicit override plus global soft-quota. Thoughts?

maria_pm: Can you sketch the problematic case? short example helps.

alex_dev: tenant T pro-plan sets `route: variant-b` override. Global policy: soft-quota -> prefer cheaper variant, fallback rules allow `variant-a, variant-c`. Which wins when tenant override conflicts with soft-quota nudges?

samir_sre: short answer: explicit tenant override must win for correctness. Soft-quota is a hint for routing, not enforcement. But we have customers expecting quotas to force variant downgrade.

jess_product: +1 on explicit override precedence. But we need a clear UX that shows "effective policy" combining stacking rules. Console should show: Effective route, why chosen (explicit override / soft-quota / fallback), and telemetry links.

alex_dev: agreed. Proposal: 1) Console editor shows rule layers (tenant, plan, org, global) with toggle to preview effective result. 2) Soft-quota should only apply when tenant has no hard override. 3) Add a "force routing" checkbox if tenant wants platform-enforced variant.

maria_pm: UI copy: "soft-quota: suggests lower-cost variant when capacity is constrained; does not override tenant-level route." Also add a small ? tooltip linking to page about cost/latency tradeoffs.

samir_sre: Telemetry side: emit `routing.decision` events with fields: `decision_layer`, `quota_state` (`ok/warning/overdraw`), `chosen_variant`, `candidate_variants`. Helps debugging.

alex_dev: example event payload in logs:

```
{ "tenant": "acct-123", "decision_layer": "tenant_override", "quota_state": "warning", "chosen_variant": "variant-b", "candidates": ["variant-b","variant-a"] }
```

jess_product: API debate: should routing policy be strict typed schema or free expression language? typed schema easier for console and validation; expression gives power. I'd vote typed + an "advanced" JSON blob for fallback rules.

samir_sre: +1 typed schema. We keep an escape hatch `advanced_rules` (raw JSON) that we don't evaluate in console preview but still accepted with warnings.

ops_bot: deploybot: routing-policy-service v2 rolled out to staging at 2026-03-19T10:02Z :rocket: 

alex_dev: cool. I'll draft a PR for console preview and add telemetry events. tagging @maria_pm for copy and @samir_sre for event spec review. Any objections? :thumbsup:

maria_pm: none from me. :+1:

samir_sre: lgtm, will add schema tests.
